meta.name: BuzzFeed Celeb
meta.description:
From the latest celebrity headlines to favorite
hilariously mundane happenings, BuzzFeed is here to
keep you updated on what all your favorite celebs
are up to.

Shows: Best Of Puppy Interviews, Hasan Minhaj, Nick Kroll & Jamie Foxx Talk Comedy, Bong Joon Ho, Taika Waititi & James Gunn Talk Filmmaking, BTS & WayV Play With Puppies, Priyanka Chopra Jonas & Jonas Brothers Talk Life & Career
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
